instruction: A candid outdoor full shot shows a group of friends cheering on a grassy park field. On the right, the bald man in a dark blue t-shirt (R2) leans forward with his hands near his chest, looking left with an intense expression. To his left, the woman in a dark blue t-shirt (R4) leans forward, shouting excitedly towards the left. In the background, the man in a red polo shirt (R3) stands on the left, and the woman in a red t-shirt and black beanie (R5) stands behind the bald man (R2). The group is closely gathered, reacting dynamically to the game. The lighting is bright, natural daylight casting soft shadows on the grass.
